tickets.title: Pre-launch QA (guest): every public URL answers
tickets.scope: Test only, as a guest: never log in, never change code or data. Site: https://elme-hyva.local (production for comparison: https://www.elmeliving.com). Check at 390 px and 1440 px unless the ticket says otherwise. Crawl from the home page: every link of the header menu, mobile menu, footer and home page, plus 30 products and 15 categories picked across the catalogue. Record status, final URL after redirects and time to first byte. Report every problem on one line, worst first: URL, viewport, steps, what you saw, what you expected, screenshot file. A page or feature that is not built yet is a finding, not a reason to stop.
qa: No URL answers 5xx, and none shows an exception, stack trace or "There has been an error processing your request"
No internal link ends in 404 or in a redirect chain longer than one hop
No broken images (naturalWidth 0) on the crawled pages
No http:// asset or link on an https page
Slowest page answers in under 3 s on the local stack; the five slowest are listed
